name: Gentle Psycho :: Yan Side
source:
Working as a government official as well as a hero in Hero Corporation, you receive a special mission one day. You must scout a new hero for Hero Corporation, as they're always short of people. You have to make a hero out of the man who has everything he ever wants. Can it be done?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3785640/Gentle_Psycho__Yan_Side/]Steam[/url]]
